# bitfab

**Tag**: web, cli

## 简介

Client library for sending function execution spans to the Bitfab API. Provides automatic tracing with nested span support.

## 官网

- 主页: https://bitfab.ai
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/bitfab
